ney's: I passed Ney’s statue standing among the new-leaved chestnut-trees in the arc-light.
ney: He looked very fine, Marshal Ney in his top-boots, gesturing with his sword among the green new horse-chestnut leaves.
neygah: "To t'ink a handsam gal like dat would-ah tek up wi' a dam black neygah man like him, he, w'en she could a stay wit' me 'n do bettah.
Oxley, his incredible eyes big and white, "dat dah neygah man ent ha' de graciousness in 'e 'art fuh sen' yo' a ha'penny fuh de chirrun awl dis time?"
"Fust I taught it wuz a duppy--one o' de mans in de canes come back fo' haunt de po' neygah."
"Oi' don't hav' to low-rate myself fi' suit any field han' neygah uman like yo'."
No wooden foot neygah man can frighten me wit' he clothes or he barrels o' cologne...."
"Hey, a big neygah uman like yo' hit a little boy like dis.
neygahs: All yo' buckras t'ink unna know mo' dan we neygahs.
neyther: They’n brought him neyther me-at nor be-acon, nor wage to lay by, if he didn’t save it wi’ clemmin’ his own inside.
